source.title: Aeva and Wideye by AGC to Showcase First FMCW In-cabin 4D LiDAR Integration at CES 2025

evidence.claim: Wideye by AGC independently confirms a jointly demonstrated functional Aeva Atlas FMCW 4D LiDAR behind-windshield integration. Wideye states its custom-formulated glass is compatible with Aeva's FMCW wavelength, increases infrared transmission while maintaining LiDAR point-cloud quality, and supports full detection range.
evidence.relevance: Adds named partner-side primary corroboration of passenger-vehicle integration feasibility and optical-interface performance; it does not establish OEM PPAP, production acceptance, purchase volume, realized revenue, or Atlas Ultra series-production acceptance.
limitations: Atlas rather than proof of Atlas Ultra OEM production acceptance
No named OEM production release or PPAP
